text: Appeal of a Property Standards Order (December 20, 2022) for 1175 Broadview Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (December 20, 2022) for 1175 Broadview Avenue, Folder Number: 22 240889 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to July 31, 2023.
